title: Ubukumkani apho isiphelo somlawuli sasingabonakali khona
intro: Imbali ibazi abalawuli bazo zonke iintlobo, kodwa bambalwa ababelawula ummandla ofana nalo. Apho umoya ngokwawo wawuphendula umyalelo wabo kwaye abasebenzi ababengenakubonwa liliso lomntu besebenza nzima bethule, olu lawulo lwalungafani nolunye ngaphambili okanye emva koko. Kodwa ke nobukumkani obukhulu kufuneka buphele—kwaye xa obu buphelile, inyaniso yavela kumthombo othobekileyo kangangokuba akukho mntu wayecinga ukuba uyayikrokrela.
clues: Ndanikwa ubukumkani obukhulu yiNkosi yam, ekuthethwa ngabo kumaphepha angcwele.
Ndizuze ubulumko negunya elikhulu kumzali owayehamba phambi kwam ngokuzinikela.
Ndiwuyalele umoya, waza wahamba umgama omde ngenxa yeenjongo zam.
Izidalwa ezingabonwayo emehlweni aqhelekileyo zasebenza phantsi kwegunya lam, zakha imimangaliso engenakuthelekiswa nanto.
Imithombo yobhedu olunyibilikisiweyo yaphuma kum, intsikelelo ekhethekileyo phakathi kwabo bakhethwe nguAllah.
Xa ndandishiya eli hlabathi, umzimba wam wahlala umi ngenduku. Kuphela xa isidalwa esincinci somhlaba satya ngaloo ntonga apho abo babendingqongile baqonda ukuba ndidlulile.

arabic: فَلَمَّا قَضَيْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَوْتَ مَا دَلَّهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَوْتِهِۦٓ إِلَّا دَآبَّةُ ٱلْأَرْضِ تَأْكُلُ مِنسَأَتَهُۥ ۖ فَلَمَّا خَرَّ تَبَيَّنَتِ ٱلْجِنُّ أَن لَّوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْغَيْبَ مَا لَبِثُوا۟ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
verse: And when We decreed for him [i.e., Solomon] death, nothing indicated to them [i.e., the jinn] his death except a creature of the earth eating his staff. But when he fell, it became clear to the jinn that if they had known the unseen, they would not have remained in humiliating punishment. (34:14)
